needs_list.description: Image recognition and text extraction concept. Shows a photo or image being analyzed, with text appearing or being extracted from it. Visual concept for OCR (Optical Character Recognition) or image-to-text AI technology.

Visual Question Answering (VQA) concept. Shows an image with a question mark or someone asking about the image content. Represents AI analyzing an image and answering questions about what it contains.
Artificial Intelligence introduction icon. Robot, brain, neural network, or technology symbols. Should convey the concept of AI and machine learning in a friendly, approachable way.
Machine Learning concept. Shows algorithms, data processing, or learning pattern. Can depict a robot learning or data flowing through a system.
